notes.summary: One line for any agent (start.md): Claude Code installs, other chat agents use Runik right away; any answer as a Runik PDF (runik_pdf.py)
Automatic updates: update.sh checks once a day, installs new versions and tells Claude what to do (re-read rules, republish or create the board)
Everything Runik produces is in the user's language (drawings, cards, chat line); board UI follows the browser language (English, Turkish)
English everywhere and a single global skill (~/.claude/skills/runik): rules, tools and board ship inside the skill; one board for all projects
Object drawing: real objects shaded and in natural colors (Visual Explainer technique, runik_object.py); the board keeps shadow filters
Expert review: bars from 0, one-meaning marks, map rules, runik-lint
First rule set: 760 grid, five type sizes, color roles, eight patterns
